strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗前线！{SCROLL}你是第一次来的训练家吧,{NEWLINE}这边请！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!{SCROLL}This is your first visit?{NEWLINE}Right this way, please!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎呀！你有{NEWLINE}战斗记录器啊！真棒！{SCROLL}第一次来的训练家的{NEWLINE}战斗记录器{CLEAR}要升级成{CLEAR}战斗前线版本。{SCROLL}先给我吧,{SCROLL}唔~只要这地方稍微{NEWLINE}弄一下……！{SCROLL}好了！{NEWLINE}给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh! You have a Vs. Recorder! Great!{SCROLL}First-time visitors get their{NEWLINE}Vs. Recorder upgraded to{CLEAR}the Battle Frontier version.{SCROLL}Let me have it for a second.{SCROLL}Hmm, just a little tweak here...!{SCROLL}There! Here you go!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}的战斗记录器{NEWLINE}升级了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}’s Vs. Recorder was{NEWLINE}upgraded.

strings.zh: 关于战斗前线{NEWLINE}各种设施的说明{CLEAR}会有其他工作人员{CLEAR}进行讲解！{SCROLL}我负责全面地{NEWLINE}回答一些你的问题。{SCROLL}有什么要问的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Other staff members will explain{NEWLINE}the Battle Frontier’s facilities.{SCROLL}I answer general questions.{SCROLL}Is there anything you’d like to ask?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.en: Which topic should I explain? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 战斗前线{NEWLINE}共有５间设施。{SCROLL}车轮战７组训练员的{NEWLINE}战斗塔。{SCROLL}留下精灵的记录的{NEWLINE}战斗舞台。{SCROLL}用租借到的精灵{NEWLINE}进行战斗的战斗工厂。{SCROLL}用积攒到的点数{NEWLINE}进行攻克的战斗城堡。{SCROLL}根据状况不同会出现{NEWLINE}各种戏剧性场面的战斗轮盘。{SCROLL}总有一个{NEWLINE}你会喜欢的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Battle Frontier has five facilities.{SCROLL}The Battle Tower, where you battle{NEWLINE}seven Trainers one after another.{SCROLL}The Battle Hall, where your Pokémon{NEWLINE}leave their records.{SCROLL}The Battle Factory, where you battle{NEWLINE}with rental Pokémon.{SCROLL}The Battle Castle, which you conquer{NEWLINE}with the points you build up.{SCROLL}And the Battle Arcade, where all kinds{NEWLINE}of dramatic twists happen depending on{CLEAR}the situation.{SCROLL}There’s bound to be one you’ll like!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0103/5 | RV043: meaning: stale US facility summaries; 'there's bound to be one you'll like'

strings.zh: 在战斗前线的５个{NEWLINE}设施中进行的战斗{CLEAR}都有特殊的规定。{SCROLL}首先是没有经验值！{SCROLL}即使参加多次战斗的精灵{NEWLINE}也不能升级。{SCROLL}另外,等级５０这个规则{NEWLINE}会让５０级以上的精灵{CLEAR}也会调整到５０级时的{CLEAR}能力。{SCROLL}不到５０级的精灵{NEWLINE}则还是保持原等级。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The battles at the five Battle Frontier{NEWLINE}facilities are held under special rules.{SCROLL}First and foremost, no Exp. Points{NEWLINE}can be earned.{SCROLL}Consequently, the Pokémon battling{NEWLINE}here will not level up.{SCROLL}If the Level 50 rule is chosen,{NEWLINE}Pokémon of higher levels will be{CLEAR}temporarily reduced to Lv. 50.{SCROLL}Pokémon under Lv. 50 will be entered{NEWLINE}without an upward level adjustment.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 战斗点数……{NEWLINE}一般称为ＢＰ。{SCROLL}ＢＰ是能够在战斗前线内{NEWLINE}使用的一种点数。{SCROLL}在各种设施内{NEWLINE}达成特定的条件{CLEAR}就能获得。{SCROLL}ＢＰ能在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}点数交换点{CLEAR}交换奖品。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Battle Points... usually called BP.{SCROLL}BP are points you can use{NEWLINE}inside the Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}You earn them by meeting{NEWLINE}certain goals at each facility.{SCROLL}You can trade BP for prizes{NEWLINE}at the Battle Frontier’s{CLEAR}Exchange Service Corner.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 点数交换点{NEWLINE}只要穿过这儿就到了,{CLEAR}那是个帐篷。{SCROLL}在点数交换点{NEWLINE}你能用你手上的ＢＰ{CLEAR}交换到各种各样的{CLEAR}奖品。{CLEAR}一定要好好利用啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Exchange Service Corner is{NEWLINE}just through here. It’s in a tent.{SCROLL}At the Exchange Service Corner,{NEWLINE}you can trade your BP for all kinds of{CLEAR}prizes. Be sure to make good use of it!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 成绩屏幕在{NEWLINE}前线各设施的{CLEAR}受理处附近都有。{SCROLL}能够确认上次的成绩{NEWLINE}和至今为止{CLEAR}最好的记录。{SCROLL}
strings.en: There’s a Records screen{NEWLINE}near the reception desk{CLEAR}of each Frontier facility.{SCROLL}It shows your last results{NEWLINE}and your best records so far.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么请走好！
strings.en: Enjoy yourself!

strings.en: The Battle Factory is the building{NEWLINE}ahead on the right as you{CLEAR}enter the Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}At the Battle Factory, you battle{NEWLINE}opponent after opponent{CLEAR}with rental Pokémon.{SCROLL}When you win, you can trade one of your{NEWLINE}Pokémon for one of your opponent’s.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 战斗舞台就是{NEWLINE}进入战斗前线后{CLEAR}在左前方的建筑。{SCROLL}战斗舞台{NEWLINE}是用喜欢的精灵{CLEAR}进行１ｖｓ１战斗,{CLEAR}看能坚持到第几场的地方。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Battle Hall is at the upper-left{NEWLINE}corner of the Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}Here, you enter one Pokémon of your{NEWLINE}choosing for one-on-one battles.{SCROLL}The objective is to keep your winning{NEWLINE}streak going as long as possible.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么请走好！
strings.en: Enjoy yourself!

strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!{SCROLL}Should I explain how the{NEWLINE}Battle Castle works? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 战斗城堡就是{NEWLINE}进入战斗前线后{CLEAR}在右后方的建筑。{SCROLL}战斗城堡{NEWLINE}能够用胜利获得的{CLEAR}城堡点数{SCROLL}进行精灵的回复,{NEWLINE}还能租借道具和果实,{CLEAR}借此不断进行车轮战。{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Battle Castle is the building at{NEWLINE}the back left as you enter the{CLEAR}Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}At the Battle Castle, you can use the{NEWLINE}Castle Points you earn by winning...{SCROLL}...to heal your Pokémon and rent items{NEWLINE}and Berries, so you can keep battling{CLEAR}one opponent after another.{SCROLL}

strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Frontier!{SCROLL}Should I explain how the{NEWLINE}Battle Arcade works? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 战斗轮盘就是{NEWLINE}进入战斗前线后{CLEAR}在左后方的建筑。{SCROLL}战斗轮盘{NEWLINE}在进行战斗前{CLEAR}会先转轮盘,！{SCROLL}有时对自己有好处有时会亏……{NEWLINE}有时能直接晋级。{CLEAR}对应各种不同的状况{CLEAR}你能走到哪一步呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Battle Arcade is the building at{NEWLINE}the back right as you enter the{CLEAR}Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}At the Battle Arcade, a roulette{NEWLINE}board spins before every battle!{SCROLL}Sometimes it helps you, sometimes it{NEWLINE}costs you... and sometimes it even{CLEAR}lets you advance straight away. How{CLEAR}far can you get, handling every{CLEAR}situation that comes up?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0103/30; ext-review RA-H02 | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-1356, D-1496).

strings.zh: 那么请走好！
strings.en: Enjoy yourself!

strings.zh: 这前面是战斗前线！{SCROLL}虽然我曾{NEWLINE}在全世界进行过冒险,{CLEAR}但让我这么兴奋的{CLEAR}这还是第一次！{SCROLL}到底有怎么样的训练家,{NEWLINE}怎么样的战斗在等着我呢……{SCROLL}真是充满了未知的挑战啊！
strings.en: The Battle Frontier is up ahead!{NEWLINE}I have explored places all over the{CLEAR}world, but nothing compares to the{CLEAR}excitement I feel right now!{SCROLL}What kinds of Trainers will I see?{NEWLINE}What battles will I experience?{SCROLL}It’s a whole new adventure for me!

strings.zh: 战斗前线的５个设施,{SCROLL}塔,还有工厂,{SCROLL}舞台,城堡,轮盘,{SCROLL}无论哪一个都是为了{NEWLINE}引导训练家锻炼出强力技术。{SCROLL}强力当然指的就是力量！{NEWLINE}技术就是讲究技巧！{SCROLL}哦~{NEWLINE}如此一针见血地就{CLEAR}点明了对战的精髓！
strings.en: The Battle Frontier’s five facilities...{SCROLL}The Tower, and the Factory...{SCROLL}The Hall, the Castle, the Arcade...{SCROLL}Every one of them exists to guide{NEWLINE}Trainers to forge power and technique.{SCROLL}Power, of course, means{NEWLINE}strength! Technique means skill!{SCROLL}Ohh! What a razor-sharp summary{NEWLINE}of the essence of battling!
strings.notes: Wordplay: 强力技术 = 强力 (power) + 技术 (technique).

strings.zh: 战斗记录器真是好啊！{SCROLL}看下前线记录{NEWLINE}就能马上知道自己有{CLEAR}多少ＢＰ了！
strings.en: The Vs. Recorder is sure nifty!{SCROLL}Checking the Frontier Record{NEWLINE}will tell you how much BP you have.

strings.zh: 我的梦想是将与战斗塔的{NEWLINE}光郎大人的战斗{CLEAR}保存到战斗记录器上！{SCROLL}但是战斗记录器{NEWLINE}忘在家里了……{SCROLL}太悲剧了~！
strings.en: My dream is to battle Palmer of the{NEWLINE}Battle Tower.{SCROLL}I want to record it for posterity on{NEWLINE}my Vs. Recorder.{SCROLL}But I left my Vs. Recorder{NEWLINE}at home... I’m heartbroken!

strings.zh: 你是第一次来战斗前线吗？{NEWLINE}没有战斗记录器的话{CLEAR}在这里可是很不方便的。{SCROLL}为了让你也能体会到{NEWLINE}战斗前线的乐趣,{CLEAR}这个战斗记录器你拿着吧！
strings.en: Is this your first time at the Battle{NEWLINE}Frontier? Things are really inconvenient{CLEAR}here without a Vs. Recorder.{SCROLL}So you can enjoy the Battle Frontier{NEWLINE}too, take this Vs. Recorder!
